screen: Registered T2 orphan-link-length county-held-out residual screen; diagnostic-only unless fixed gates pass

measure_before.link_filter: provided subclass containing link or class containing _link; orphan status by connector incidence

method.feature: Use the frozen registered T2|R|covariate:orphan_link_length_km emission only; the screen does not reread or rebuild Overture roads.
method.upstream_recipe: Pinned T2 harness diagnostics confirm the fixed named classes, link filter, connector neighbor rule, and configured 2,000 m value. The registered v1 emission is qualifying link-segment length clipped to each tract, in kilometers; it does not accumulate attached non-link carriageway length. This distinction is preserved rather than relabeling another feature.
method.outcome: Pinned frozen S1 cross-fitted Queen/Rook estimator-disagreement residual; no target or reference layer read.
method.validation: Within each official region, hold out each supported five-digit county FIPS in turn; fit on all other supported counties in that region.
method.correction: OLS intercept plus one registered T2 term. Feature mean and population SD computed on training counties only; held-out features use those training statistics; zero SD scale=1.
method.baseline: Zero correction of frozen S1 residual on identical support.
method.metric: Pooled and regional county-held-out ΔR²=(baseline SSE - OOF model SSE)/baseline SSE; 2,000 paired county-block bootstrap replicates within region.
method.urban_rural: Descriptive breakdown using only provided pct_urban: rural <0.5, urban >=0.5; missing excluded.
method.interpretation_limit: Residual association only, not target accuracy, causal evidence, or estimator-promotion evidence.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-county baseline/model SSE blocks; counties sampled with replacement within each official region

provided_urbanity.source: provided pct_urban, used only to stratify descriptive results

interpretation: The registered T2 orphan-link-length screen failed one or more fixed acceptance gates; retain diagnostic-only and do not integrate.
